title: Find how to cancel, claim or renegotiate with a real merchant
goal: The user pays {{merchant}} (statement line "{{descriptor}}", finding: {{kind}}). Starting from the web search, open the merchant's OWN official website and find: (1) the page that explains how to {{action}} (cancellation, refund or dispute, or plan change), (2) the current plan prices or fees on the official site, (3) a support contact (email, form page or phone). Record an evidence screenshot on each page you rely on. NEVER log in, create an account, submit any form, or click anything that changes an account; you only read. If the statement line does not name an identifiable company, call complete and say so. Finish by calling complete with a summary in this exact JSON shape: {"site":"https://...","cancelUrl":"...","pricingUrl":"...","supportUrl":"...","prices":"one line","howTo":"two sentences on how the user cancels or claims","notes":"anything the user should know"} with null for anything not found.

merchant.description: Merchant name as it appears on the statement

kind.description: What was found on this line (e.g. subscription to review)

action.description: What the user wants to do (cancel, refund, renegotiate)

query.description: The search query to start from

hints.hint: The start page is a web search. Pick the result that is the merchant's own domain, not a review site or an app store listing.

If the search page shows a bot challenge or a site answers Access Denied, go straight to the obvious official domain (https://www.<merchant>.com, then its /help, /support or /pricing path) and try the help subdomain (help., support.). If the official site stays blocked, say so in notes; never guess links you did not open.
Cancellation and refund instructions usually live under Help, Support, FAQ or Account pages; use the site search if there is one.
Pricing is usually at /pricing, /plans or /products. Note the plan that matches the amount on the statement.
Do not log in or submit anything. If a page demands sign-in to continue, record it and move on.

evidenceCheckpoints.description: The page explaining how to cancel, refund or change the plan
